rules.rule_text: Evaluate each option independently using the stated aggregation and apply the inequality exactly as written, distinguishing inclusive conditions such as "<=" from strict conditions such as ">" or "exceeds".

After identifying the relevant sustained transition, return its earliest timestamp as the window start and verify that the complete requested number of consecutive observations remains within the supplied series.

Identify the earliest timestamp where the robot's position or setpoint trajectory begins a sustained retreat from the bin, using coordinated directional changes across relevant axes rather than an isolated effort-signal fluctuation.
